note: Barks for the three Ward residents (showcase phase 2, 20 Nov 2026). Same schema, model and voice settings as art/showcase_20261119/npc_life/barks.json; read by generate_voices.py here and by WardResidentsInstall20261120 (BarkSet assets Data/Barks/barks_<id>.asset, takes Audio/ElevenLabs/NpcBarks/<id>-<line>.wav). Walkers speak Passing lines when the player comes within 3.2 m; while a resident stands at a work stop BarkDirector also lets it make Idle remarks (player within 9 m and in sight). hours = [from, to) on CityTimeOfDay.

voice.name: Kirsty
voice.assigned: 20 Nov 2026 (residents: Karaveen produce and pottery trader)

lines.text: Fresh off the caravan. Dates, beans and salt.
Water jars, sealed and tested. Mind your feet.
Every jar on this table crossed the Berms on a beast's back.
Dust front's coming. I can smell it. Cover the grain.
Ward keeps its lamps low. Good for prices, bad for eyes.
Holster that. Nobody haggles at gunpoint.
Bay two's live. Stand clear of the canisters.
Forty-one in, nine out. Don't make me count again.
Goods only through the Tube. People still ask.
Scale's reading heavy again. Sand in the plate.
Night shift. The node runs on half power, so we count slow.

voice.name: Bill
voice.assigned: 20 Nov 2026 (residents: old water carrier from the south wall homes)

lines.text: Two cans a house. Same as in my father's day.
Mind the old man. Slow, but he gets there.
Cold, from the deep rock. Best water on Tir.
Forty years I've lived on that wall. It's never fallen.
Dust front tonight, mark me. My knees know.
Put it away, son. The Wardens are watching.
